description: This file contains utility functions used in the PyTorch distributed training framework. It includes functions for argument packing/unpacking, tensor device transfer, storage management, deep tensor application, and distributed synchronization tasks.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Any,...],tuple[str,...]] _pack_kwargs(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Turns a list of positional arguments and keyword arguments into a tuple of combined positional args and a tuple of kwarg keys.

methods.name: tuple[Any,Any] _cast_forward_inputs( dtype: torch.dtype | None, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Casts floating point tensors in args and kwargs to a specified dtype, respecting existing requires_grad flags.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Any,...],dict[str,Any]] _unpack_kwargs( flat_args: tuple[Any, ...], kwarg_keys: tuple[str, ...] )
methods.description: Reconstructs original args and kwargs tuples from flattened args and kwarg keys.

methods.name: list[S] _recursive_to( inputs: S, target_device: torch.device, use_side_stream_for_tensor_copies: bool )
methods.description: Recursively moves inputs (tensors or nested structures containing tensors) to a target device, optionally using side streams for tensor copies.

methods.name: None _p_assert(cond: Any, s: str, raise_assertion_error: bool = True)
methods.description: Prints a message and stack trace if a condition is not met, optionally raising an AssertionError.

methods.name: None _alloc_storage(tensor: torch.Tensor, size: torch.Size)
methods.description: Allocates storage for a tensor with a specified size if not already allocated.

methods.name: _free_storage(tensor: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Frees the storage of a tensor.

methods.name: Q _apply_to_tensors( fn: Callable[[torch.Tensor], Q], container: torch.Tensor )
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to all tensors within various nested container structures.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Any,...],tuple[dict[str,Any],...]] _to_kwargs( inputs: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None, target_device: torch.device, use_side_stream_for_tensor_copies: bool, )
methods.description: Moves inputs and keyword arguments to a target device, returning moved versions as tuples.

methods.name: _verify_param_shape_across_processes( process_group: dist.ProcessGroup, tensors: list[torch.Tensor], logger: Optional["dist.Logger"] = None, )
methods.description: Verifies that tensor parameters have consistent shapes across processes in a distributed setup.

methods.name: None _sync_module_states( module: nn.Module, process_group: dist.ProcessGroup, broadcast_bucket_size: int, src: int, params_and_buffers_to_ignore: Container[str], broadcast_buffers: bool = True, )
methods.description: Synchronizes the state (parameters and buffers) of a module across all processes.

methods.name: None _sync_params_and_buffers( process_group: dist.ProcessGroup, module_states: list[torch.Tensor], broadcast_bucket_size: int, src: int, )
methods.description: Broadcasts module parameters and buffers from a source process to all others.

methods.name: None _replace_by_prefix( state_dict: dict[str, Any], old_prefix: str, new_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Replaces dictionary keys' prefix strings in place.

methods.name: bool _data_ptr_allocated(tensor: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Checks if a tensor's storage has been allocated.

methods.name: list[nn.Module] _get_root_modules(modules: list[nn.Module])
methods.description: Returns modules that are root modules (not children of others in the list).
